experiment_metadata.reason: Scratch 4v1 mixed-coverage line combining the current default ingredients: K10 capture-to-coverage delay, hard boundary/death, boundary/entity proximity safety, and speed-only coverage settled success.
experiment_metadata.boundary_semantics: All scenes use hard boundary/death. Touching boundary or any collision gives collision_penalty=-160; near-boundary clearance<4m gives boundary_proximity_penalty=-10/step; entity/obstacle clearance<d_safe gives emergency_penalty=-10/step.
experiment_metadata.optimizer_semantics: 2M scratch, lr 1e-4 then 3e-5 at 1M, epsilon 0.6 to 0.05 over 1M.
experiment_metadata.is_pursuing_semantics: coverage-to-capture is immediate; capture-to-coverage remains effective capture for exactly ten action transitions. Observation, reward, hold, and replay all use the effective role.
experiment_metadata.safety_update_20260714: collision_penalty=-160; entity/obstacle proximity emergency_penalty=-10 per step at d_safe; hard-boundary proximity penalty=-10 per step inside 4m; boundary_penalty is set to -160 for clarity but remains unused by hard/death boundary mode.
experiment_metadata.coverage_supplement: Uses the existing voradj_mixed_coverage schedule, four replay buffers, and recovery_pure coverage supplement.
experiment_metadata.coverage_speed_semantics: Coverage/post-capture success keeps geometry and settled metrics separate; motion success is speed-only: max_speed<=0.30, accel/turn are logged but not required.
experiment_metadata.safety_trend_trigger: Started because the warm safety speed-only line reached roughly geometric=0.96-1.00 and settled=0.75-0.80 around 314k-317k with soft_oob=0 and mixed collision around 0.14-0.18.
experiment_metadata.new_speed_shaping_20260715: Latest scratch 4v1 mix 2M after speed shaping change: K10, hard boundary/death, boundary proximity warning, four-buffer mixed coverage/pure recovery, hard gate, old motion penalty disabled, linear +5..+15 speed shaping, +20/+240 on speed success.
experiment_metadata.training_start_seed_control: uses the same seed as A2Scratch-2M to reduce initialization confounding where possible
experiment_metadata.a3_changes_vs_a2scratch: single scratch line based on A2 4v1 config, with APF-v2_fixed explicitly enabled and voradj.center_sqrt_n_normalization_enabled=true
experiment_metadata.supervisor: tools/supervise_a3_curriculum.py; checks every 100k from 500k and selects historical best after 2M
experiment_metadata.selection_extra_metric: capture scenario avg_steps is included as a tie-breaker so faster capture is preferred after success/settle/collision criteria
experiment_metadata.device_decision: Run A3 on cuda:1 per user request; this shares GPU1 with the active CenterSqrtN curriculum.
experiment_metadata.release_scope: Final integrated CR-MS + VCT-LS + CE configuration; no intermediate experiment config is required.
experiment_metadata.capture_semantics: Direct detectors use ring_importance_ms_v0. One-hop VCT-LS support agents receive 0.5 approach-only attraction plus 0.5 CE coverage reward.
experiment_metadata.support_visibility_semantics: Attraction targets are limited to evaders directly seen by pursuing one-hop Voronoi communication neighbors; no global enemy coordinate is exposed.
experiment_metadata.coverage_semantics: CE PBRS, delayed light speed cost, strict CE success, CV<0.15 loose diagnostics, and the latest replay/recovery mix.
experiment_metadata.max_step_policy: Training episode max is 3000; post-capture windows are 500/600/700 for 4v1/8v2/12v3.
experiment_metadata.selection_policy: Rank capture/collision first, then mix and pure CE strict before legacy CV diagnostics.
